mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand for housing, which in turn drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, and ultimately driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 6% signals a strong labor market, which in turn drives consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong supply chain, which in turn drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales signals a robust demand for goods and services, which in turn drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 2% signals a tightening monetary policy, which in turn leads to decreased borrowing and spending, and ultimately drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 5% and an increase in payroll employment above 200,000 signals a strong labor market, which in turn drives consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong payroll employment growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP and a decrease in the unemployment rate below 6% signal a robust demand for goods and services, which in turn drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).
